{
  "contents": "// Configuration manager to handle application settings\nclass ConfigManager {\n  constructor() {\n    this.config = {};\n    this.loadConfig();\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Load configuration from localStorage\n   */\n  loadConfig() {\n    try {\n      // First try to load from localStorage\n      const savedConfig = localStorage.getItem(\"translator_rewriter_config\");\n      if (savedConfig) {\n        this.config = JSON.parse(savedConfig);\n      } else {\n        this.config = {};\n      }\n\n      // If running in Electron, try to load from file and merge\n      if (window.electronAPI) {\n        const fileConfig = window.electronAPI.readConfig();\n        // readConfig() always returns an object (never null), either from config.json or config_default.json\n        if (fileConfig &amp;&amp; Object.keys(fileConfig).length &gt; 0) {\n          this.config = { ...this.config, ...fileConfig };\n          console.log(\"Loaded config from file:\", this.config);\n        }\n      }\n      \n      // If config is still empty after all attempts, log a warning\n      // This should not happen in Electron since readConfig() creates config from defaults\n      if (Object.keys(this.config).length === 0) {\n        console.warn(\"No configuration loaded. This may cause issues.\");\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"Error loading config:\", error);\n      // Keep empty config - readConfig() should have handled defaults\n    }\n  }\n\n  persistToFile() {\n    try {\n      const electronRequire =\n        typeof window !== \"undefined\" &amp;&amp; window.require ? window.require : null;\n      if (!electronRequire) return;\n      const fs = electronRequire(\"fs\");\n      const path = electronRequire(\"path\");\n      const filePath = path.join(process.cwd(), \"config.json\");\n      fs.writeFileSync(filePath, JSON.stringify(this.config, null, 2), \"utf8\");\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"Error writing config file:\", error);\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Save configuration to localStorage and disk (Electron)\n   */\n  saveConfig() {\n    try {\n      localStorage.setItem(\n        \"translator_rewriter_config\",\n        JSON.stringify(this.config),\n      );\n      this.persistToFile();\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"Error saving config:\", error);\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Get a configuration value\n   * @param {string} key - Configuration key\n   * @returns {*} Configuration value\n   */\n  get(key) {\n    return this.config[key];\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Set a configuration value\n   * @param {string} key - Configuration key\n   * @param {*} value - Configuration value\n   */\n  set(key, value) {\n    this.config[key] = value;\n    this.saveConfig();\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Get all configuration\n   * @returns {Object} All configuration\n   */\n  getAll() {\n    return { ...this.config };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Set multiple configuration values\n   * @param {Object} config - Configuration object\n   */\n  setAll(config) {\n    this.config = { ...this.config, ...config };\n    this.saveConfig();\n  }\n}\n\nexport default new ConfigManager();\n",

        "contents": "export const AppProvider = \n\n\n  // Update a single setting\n  const setSetting = (key, value) =&gt; {\n    configManager.set(key, value);\n    const updatedSettings = configManager.getAll();\n    setSettings(updatedSettings);\n\n    // Update the API service base URL when settings change\n    if (key === \"api_url\") {\n      apiService.setBaseUrl(value || \"https://openrouter.ai/api/v1\");\n    }\n    \n    // Update languages state when available_languages changes\n    if (key === \"available_languages\") {\n      // Create a new array reference to ensure React detects the change\n      const newLanguages = Array.isArray(value) ? [...value] : (value || []);\n      setLanguages(newLanguages);\n      \n      // Notify other windows about the settings update\n      if (window.electronAPI &amp;&amp; window.electronAPI.notifySettingsUpdated) {\n        window.electronAPI.notifySettingsUpdated();\n      }\n    }\n    \n    // Update availableModels state when available_models changes\n    if (key === \"available_models\") {\n      // Create a new array reference to ensure React detects the change\n      const newModels = Array.isArray(value) ?         "contents": "export const AppProvider = \n() =&gt; {\nconst loadData = async \n\n    };\n\n    loadData();\n\n    // Listen for settings updates from other windows\n    if (window.electronAPI &amp;&amp; window.electronAPI.onSettingsUpdated) {\n      window.electronAPI.onSettingsUpdated(() =&gt; {\n        // Reload config without triggering a full re-render of everything if possible?\n        // Actually we want to re-render settings dependent values.\n        configManager.loadConfig(); // Force reload from file/localstorage\n        setSettings(configManager.getAll());\n\n        // Also refresh models/availability if that changed\n        setAvailableModels(configManager.get(\"available_models\") || []);\n        \n        // Also refresh languages if that changed\n        setLanguages(configManager.get(\"available_languages\") || []);\n\n        // Update API base URL just in case\n        apiService.setBaseUrl(\n          configManager.get(\"api_url\") || \"https://openrouter.ai/api/v1\",\n        );\n      });\n    }\n  }, []);\n\n  // Expose calculateCost function for use elsewhere\n  const getCalculateCost = () =&gt; calculateCost;\n\n  const computeCostFromUsage = (modelId, promptTokens, completionTokens) =&gt; {\n    const pricing =\n      allModels.find((m) =&gt; m.id === modelId)?.pricing ||\n      settings.cached_models?.find((m) =&gt; m.id === modelId)?.pricing;\n    const promptRate = parseFloat(pricing?.prompt ?? 0);\n    const completionRate = parseFloat(pricing?.completion ?? 0);\n    if (promptRate || completionRate) {\n      return promptTokens * promptRate + completionTokens * completionRate;\n    }\n    // If pricing is missing, treat as free (avoid default/fallback pricing).\n    return 0;\n  };\n\n  const writeLastApiResult = (payload) =&gt;\n;\n;",

        "contents": "import os\n\nimport requests\nfrom openai import OpenAI\n\n\nclass OpenRouterClient:\n    def __init__(self, api_key, base_url=\"https://openrouter.ai/api/v1\"):\n        self.api_key = api_key\n        self.base_url = base_url\n        self.client = OpenAI(\n            base_url=self.base_url,\n            api_key=api_key,\n        )\n\n    def get_available_models(self):\n        \"\"\"Fetches the list of available models from OpenRouter.\"\"\"\n        try:\n            response = requests.get(\n                f\"{self.base_url}/models\",\n                headers={\"Authorization\": f\"Bearer {self.api_key}\"},\n            )\n            response.raise_for_status()\n            data = response.json()\n            # Return the full list of model objects\n            return data[\"data\"]\n        except Exception as e:\n            # Silently return empty list on error\n            return []\n\n    def chat_completion(self, model, messages):\n        \"\"\"Sends a chat completion request to the LLM.\"\"\"",

        "contents": "class APIService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Rewrite text with specified style\n   * @param {string} text - Text to rewrite\n   * @param {string} style - Style to apply\n   * @param {string} model - Model to use for rewriting\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;Object&gt;} Rewrite result with content and usage\n   */\n  async rewrite(text, style, model) {\n    try {\n      const stylePrompts = {\n        \"Check Spelling &amp; Grammar\":\n          \"Correct the spelling and grammar of the following text. Maintain the original meaning.\",\n        \"Improve Clarity\":\n          \"Rewrite the following text to improve its clarity and flow.\",\n        \"Make Formal\":\n          \"Rewrite the following text to make it more formal and professional.\",\n        \"Make Informal\":\n          \"Rewrite the following text to make it more casual and informal.\",\n        Shorten:\n          \"Condense the following text, keeping only the essential information.\",\n        Expand: \"Expand on the following text, adding more detail and context.\",\n        \"Make Technical\":\n          \"Rewrite the following text using more technical terminology appropriate for the context.\",\n      };\n\n      const prompt = stylePrompts[style] || \"Rewrite the following text.\";\n\n      const response = await fetch(&#96;${this.baseUrl}/chat/completions&#96;, {\n        method: \"POST\",\n        headers: this.getHeaders(),\n        body: JSON.stringify({\n          model: model,\n          messages: [\n            {\n              role: \"system\",\n              content: &#96;${prompt} Only provide the rewritten text, no introductory or concluding remarks.&#96;,\n            },\n            { role: \"user\", content: text },\n          ],\n        }),\n      });\n\n      if (!response.ok) {\n        throw new Error(&#96;HTTP error! status: ${response.status}&#96;);\n      }\n\n      const data = await response.json();\n\n      if (!data.choices || data.choices.length === 0) {\n        throw new Error(\"No choices returned from API\");\n      }\n\n      const result = {\n        content: data.choices[0].message.content,\n,\n      };\n  }",

        "contents": "class APIService {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Translate text from source language to target language\n   * @param {string} text - Text to translate\n   * @param {string} targetLang - Target language\n   * @param {string} model - Model to use for translation\n   * @param {string} sourceLang - Source language (optional)\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;Object&gt;} Translation result with content and usage\n   */\n  async translate(text, targetLang, model, sourceLang = null) {\n    try {\n      let prompt;\n      if (sourceLang &amp;&amp; sourceLang !== \"Detect Language\") {\n        prompt = &#96;You are a professional translator. Translate the following text from ${sourceLang} into ${targetLang}. Only provide the translation, no introductory or concluding remarks.&#96;;\n      } else {\n        prompt = &#96;You are a professional translator. Translate the following text into ${targetLang}. Only provide the translation, no introductory or concluding remarks.&#96;;\n      }\n\n      const response = await fetch(&#96;${this.baseUrl}/chat/completions&#96;, {\n        method: \"POST\",\n        headers: this.getHeaders(),\n        body: JSON.stringify({\n          model: model,\n          messages: [\n            { role: \"system\", content: prompt },\n            { role: \"user\", content: text },\n          ],\n        }),\n      });\n\n      if (!response.ok) {\n        throw new Error(&#96;HTTP error! status: ${response.status}&#96;);\n      }\n\n      const data = await response.json();\n\n      if (!data.choices || data.choices.length === 0) {\n        throw new Error(\"No choices returned from API\");\n      }\n\n      const result = {\n        content: data.choices[0].message.content,\n        usage: data.usage,\n        model: model,\n      };\n\n      this.writeLastApiResult({\n        type: \"translate\",\n        model,\n        usage: data.usage,\n        raw: data,\n      });\n\n      return result;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"Translation error:\", error);\n      return {\n        error: error.message,\n      };\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Rewrite text with specified style\n   * @param {string} text - Text to rewrite\n   * @param {string} style - Style to apply\n   * @param {string} model - Model to use for rewriting\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;Object&gt;} Rewrite result with content and usage\n   */\n}",

        },
        "contents": "class ProxyHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):\n\n    \n    def proxy_request(self):\n        \"\"\"\n        Main proxy logic: forward request to OpenRouter and stream response back\n        \"\"\"\n        client_ip = self.client_address[0]\n        try:\n            # Construct target URL\n            url = f\"{self.TARGET_SCHEME}://{self.TARGET_HOST}{self.path}\"\n            logger.info(f\"[{client_ip}] {self.command} {self.path}\")\n            logger.debug(f\"[{client_ip}] Target URL: {url}\")\n            \n            # Log incoming headers (excluding sensitive ones)\n            sensitive_headers = {'authorization', 'cookie', 'x-api-key'}\n            incoming_headers = {k: v for k, v in self.headers.items() \n                              if k.lower() not in sensitive_headers}\n            logger.debug(f\"[{client_ip}] Incoming headers: {incoming_headers}\")\n            \n            # Read request body if present\n            content_length = self.headers.get('Content-Length')\n            body = None\n            if content_length:\n                try:\n                    body_len = int(content_length)\n                    logger.debug(f\"[{client_ip}] Reading request body: {body_len} bytes\")\n                    body = self.rfile.read(body_len)\n                    logger.debug(f\"[{client_ip}] Read {len(body)} bytes from request body\")\n                except Exception as e:\n                    logger.error(f\"[{client_ip}] Error reading request body: {e}\")\n                    self.send_json_error(400, \"Bad Request: Could not read body\")\n                    return\n            \n            # Create forwarding request\n            req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, method=self.command)\n            \n            # Forward headers (excluding hop-by-hop headers)\n            forwarded_headers = []\n            for key, value in self.headers.items():\n                if key.lower() not in self.HOP_BY_HOP_HEADERS:\n                    req.add_header(key, value)\n                    forwarded_headers.append(key)\n            \n            # Always set Host header to target\n            req.add_header('Host', self.TARGET_HOST)",
        "signatures": {

              "startPosition": {
                "line": 31,

        "contents": "class ProxyHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):\n    \"\"\"HTTP request handler that proxies to OpenRouter API\"\"\"\n    \n    # Target API endpoint\n    TARGET_HOST = \"openrouter.ai\"\n    TARGET_SCHEME = \"https\"\n    \n    # Headers to exclude from forwarding\n    HOP_BY_HOP_HEADERS = {\n        'connection', 'keep-alive', 'proxy-authenticate',\n        'proxy-authorization', 'te', 'trailers', 'transfer-encoding',\n        'upgrade', 'host'\n    }\n    \n    def do_GET(self):\n        \"\"\"Handle GET requests\"\"\"\n        self.proxy_request()\n    \n    def do_POST(self):\n        \"\"\"Handle POST requests\"\"\"\n        self.proxy_request()\n    \n    def do_PUT(self):\n        \"\"\"Handle PUT requests\"\"\"\n        self.proxy_request()\n    \n    def do_DELETE(self):\n        \"\"\"Handle DELETE requests\"\"\"\n        self.proxy_request()\n    \n    def do_PATCH(self):\n        \"\"\"Handle PATCH requests\"\"\"\n        self.proxy_request()\n    \n    def do_OPTIONS(self):\n        \"\"\"Handle OPTIONS requests\"\"\"\n        self.proxy_request()\n    \n    def send_json_error(self, code, message):\n        \"\"\"Send a JSON error response instead of HTML\"\"\"\n        error_response = {\n            \"error\": {\n                \"message\": message,\n                \"type\": \"proxy_error\",\n                \"code\": code\n            }\n        }\n        error_json = json.dumps(error_response).encode('utf-8')\n        \n        self.send_response(code)\n        self.send_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')\n        self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(error_json)))\n        self.end_headers()\n        self.wfile.write(error_json)\n    \n    def proxy_request(self):\n        \"\"\"",

        "contents": "const App = \nconst handleTranslate = async \n\n\n    try {\n      const result = await translate(\n        inputText,\n        targetLanguage,\n        activeModel,\n        sourceLanguage === \"Detect Language\" ? null : sourceLanguage,\n      );\n\n      // Calculate TPS\n      const endTime = Date.now();\n      const durationSeconds =\n        (endTime - tpsCalculationRef.current.startTime) / 1000;\n      const totalTokens =\n        (result.usage?.prompt_tokens || 0) +\n        (result.usage?.completion_tokens || 0);\n      const tps = durationSeconds &gt; 0 ? totalTokens / durationSeconds : 0;\n      setTokensPerSecond(tps);\n\n      // Stop timer\n      if (timerRef.current) {\n        clearInterval(timerRef.current);\n        timerRef.current = null;\n      }\n      startTimeRef.current = null;\n      setIsProcessing(false);\n      setLastRunCost(result.calculated_cost || 0);\n      setLastRunModel(result.model_used || lastRunModel || null);\n\n      if (result.content) {\n        const cleanedContent = result.content.replace(/^\\s*\\n+/, \"\");\n        setOutputText(cleanedContent);\n        // Auto-copy if enabled\n        if (settings.auto_copy) {\n          navigator.clipboard.writeText(cleanedContent);\n        }\n      } else if (result.error) {\n        setOutputText(&#96;Error: ${result.error}&#96;);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      // Stop timer on error\n      if (timerRef.current) {\n        clearInterval(timerRef.current);\n        timerRef.current = null;\n      }\n      startTimeRef.current = null;\n      setIsProcessing(false);\n      setLastRunCost(0);\n      setLastRunModel(null);\n      setOutputText(&#96;Error: ${error.message}&#96;);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleRewrite = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!inputText.trim()) return;\n;\n;",

        "contents": "const api = {\n() =&gt; {\n\n\n        if (defaultConfigPath) {\n          console.log(&#96;Loading default config from: ${defaultConfigPath}&#96;);\n          const defaultData = fs.readFileSync(defaultConfigPath, 'utf8');\n          const defaultConfig = JSON.parse(defaultData);\n          \n          // Create config.json with default values in the same directory as config_default.json\n          const configDir = path.dirname(defaultConfigPath);\n          const newConfigPath = path.join(configDir, 'config.json');\n          fs.writeFileSync(newConfigPath, JSON.stringify(defaultConfig, null, 2), 'utf8');\n          console.log(&#96;Created config.json from defaults at: ${newConfigPath}&#96;);\n          \n          return defaultConfig;\n        } else {\n          console.error('Neither config.json nor config_default.json found.         "contents": "export const AppProvider = \n\n\n  // Rewrite text\n  const rewrite = async (text, style, model) =&gt; {\n    setLoading(true);\n    setError(null);\n\n    try {\n      const result = await apiService.rewrite(text, style, model);\n\n      // Update last used model\n      // Do not overwrite last_used_model here; it is persisted via user selection in the header.\n\n      // Update total cost if applicable\n      if (result.usage) {\n        const { prompt_tokens = 0, completion_tokens = 0 } = result.usage;\n        const calculatedCost = computeCostFromUsage(\n          model,\n          prompt_tokens,\n          completion_tokens,\n        );\n        const newTotalCost = (settings.total_cost || 0) + calculatedCost;\n        setSetting(\"total_cost\", newTotalCost);\n        result.calculated_cost = calculatedCost;\n        result.total_cost = newTotalCost;\n      }\n\n      result.model_used = result.model || model;\n\n      writeLastApiResult({\n        type: \"rewrite\",\n        model: result.model_used,\n        usage: result.usage,\n        calculated_cost: result.calculated_cost,\n        total_cost: result.total_cost,\n        raw: result,\n      });\n\n      return result;\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(\"Rewrite failed\");\n      console.error(err);\n      return { error: err.message };\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  // Context value\n  const contextValue = {\n    settings,\n    models: availableModels, // Expose user selected models as 'models' for backward compat\n    allModels, // Expose full list for settings\n    availableModels,\n    languages,\n    loading,\n    error,\n    updateSettings,\n    setSetting,\n    translate,\n    rewrite,\n    calculateCost: getCalculateCost(),\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;AppContext.Provider value={contextValue}&gt;{children}&lt;/AppContext.Provider&gt;\n  );\n};\n\n// Hook to use the context\nexport const useAppContext = () =&gt;\n;",

                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"// Configuration manager to handle application settings\\nclass ConfigManager {\\n  constructor() {\\n    this.config = {};\\n    this.loadConfig();\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * Load configuration from localStorage\\n   */\\n  loadConfig() {\\n    try {\\n      // First try to load from localStorage\\n      const savedConfig = // If running in Electron, try to load from file and merge\\n      if (window.electronAPI) {\\n        const fileConfig = window.electronAPI.readConfig();\\n        if (fileConfig) {\\n          this.config = { ...this.config, ...fileConfig };\\n          console.log(\\\"Loaded config from file:\\\", this.config);\\n        }\\n\\n        if (Object.keys(this.config).length === 0) {\\n          this.setDefaultConfig();\\n        }\\n      } else {\\n        if (Object.keys(this.config).length === 0) {\\n          this.setDefaultConfig();\\n        }\\n      }\\n    } catch (error) {\\n      console.error(\\\"Error loading config:\\\", error);\\n      this.setDefaultConfig();\\n    }\\n  }\\n\\n  setDefaultConfig() {\\n    this.config = {\\n      api_key: \\\"\\\",\\n      last_used_model: \\\"\\\",\\n      available_models: [],\\n      available_languages: [],\\n      auto_copy: false,\\n      real_time_translation: false,\\n      enter_behavior: \\\"Translate\\\",\\n      font_family: \\\"Arial\\\",\\n      font_size: 14,\\n      input_text_color: \\\"#ffffff\\\",\\n      output_text_color: \\\"#ffffff\\\",\\n      window_geometry: \\\"1000x700\\\",\\n      settings_modal_geometry: { width: 950, height: 640 },\\n      total_cost: 0.0,\\n      api_url: \\\"https://openrouter.ai/api/v1\\\",\\n    };\\n  }\\n\\n  persistToFile() {\\n    try {\\n      const electronRequire =\\n        typeof window !== \\\"undefined\\\" &amp;amp;&amp;amp; window.require ? window.require : null;\\n      if (!electronRequire) return;\\n      const fs = Configuration key\\n   * @param {*} value - Configuration value\\n   */\\n  set(key, value) {\\n    this.config[key] = value;\\n    this.saveConfig();\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * Get all configuration\\n   * @returns {Object} All configuration\\n   */\\n  getAll() {\\n    return { ...this.config };\\n  }\\n\\n  /**\\n   * Set multiple configuration values\\n   * @param {Object} config - Configuration                   "content": "  \"contents\": \"import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect } from \\\"react\\\";\\nimport configManager from \\\"../utils/configManager\\\";\\nimport apiService from \\\"../services/apiService\\\";\\n\\n// Create the context\\nconst AppContext = createContext();\\n\\n// Model pricing (price per 1K tokens)\\nconst MODEL_PRICING = {\\n  \\\"gpt-3.5-turbo\\\": { input: 0.001, output: 0.002 },\\n  \\\"gpt-4\\\": { input: 0.03, output: 0.06 },\\n  \\\"claude-2\\\": { input: 0.008, output: 0.024 },\\n  \\\"claude-instant-1\\\": { input: 0.0008, output: 0.0024 },\\n  // Default fallback pricing\\n  default: { input: 0.01, output: 0.02 },\\n};\\n\\n// Calculate cost based on model and token usage\\nconst calculateCost = (model, promptTokens, completionTokens) =&amp;gt; {\\n  const pricing = MODEL_PRICING[model] || MODEL_PRICING.default;\\n  const inputCost = (promptTokens / 1000) * pricing.input;\\n  const outputCost = (completionTokens / 1000) * pricing.output;\\n  return inputCost + outputCost;\\n};\\n\\n// Provider component\\nexport const AppProvider = ({ children }) =&amp;gt; {\\n  const [settings, setSettings] = useState(configManager.getAll());\\n\\n  const [allModels, setAllModels] = useState([]);\\n  const [availableModels, setAvailableModels] = useState(\\n    configManager.get(\\\"available_models\\\") || [],\\n  );\\n  const [languages, setLanguages] = useState(\\n    configManager.get(\\\"available_languages\\\") || [],\\n  );\\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);\\n  const [error, setError] = useState(null);\\n\\n  // Load models and languages on startup\\n  useEffect(() =&amp;gt; {\\n    const loadData = async () =&amp;gt; {\\n      setLoading(true);\\n      try {\\n        // Set the API base URL from settings\\n        const currentSettings = configManager.getAll();\\n        apiService.setBaseUrl(\\n          currentSettings.api_url || \\\"https://openrouter.ai/api/v1\\\",\\n        );\\n\\n        const [loadedModels, loadedLanguages] = await Promise.all([\\n          apiService.getModels(),\\n          apiService.getLanguages(),\\n        ]);\\n\\n        if (loadedModels &amp;amp;&amp;amp; loadedModels.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n          setAllModels(loadedModels);\\n\\n          // If no available models are configured, select all by default\\n          const currentAvailable = configManager.get(\\\"available_models\\\");\\n          if (!currentAvailable || currentAvailable.length === 0) {\\n            const allIds = loadedModels.map((m) =&amp;gt; m.id);\\n            setAvailableModels(allIds);\\n            configManager.set(\\\"available_models\\\", allIds);\\n          }\\n        }\\n\\n        if (loadedLanguages &amp;amp;&amp;amp; loadedLanguages.length &amp;gt; 0) {\\n          setLanguages(loadedLanguages);\\n          // If no available languages are configured, select all (or don't overwrite user choice)\\n          // The python code defaults to all if empty?\\n          const currentLangs = configManager.get(\\\"available_languages\\\");\\n          if (!currentLangs || currentLangs.length === 0) {\\n            configManager.set(\\\"available_languages\\\", loadedLanguages);\\n          }\\n        }\\n\\n        // Update settings state\\n        setSettings(configManager.getAll());\\n      } catch (err) {\\n        setError(\\\"Failed to load models and languages\\\");\\n        console.error(err);\\n      } finally {\\n        setLoading(false);\\n      }\\n    };\\n\\n    loadData();\\n\\n    // Listen for settings updates from other windows\\n    if (window.electronAPI &amp;amp;&amp;amp; window.electronAPI.onSettingsUpdated) {\\n      window.electronAPI.onSettingsUpdated(() =&amp;gt; {\\n        // Reload config without triggering a full re-render of everything if possible?\\n        // Actually we want to re-render settings dependent values.\\n        configManager.loadConfig(); // Force reload from file/localstorage\\n        setSettings(configManager.getAll());\\n\\n        // Also refresh models/availability if that changed\\n        setAvailableModels(configManager.get(\\\"available_models\\\") || []);\\n\\n        // Update API base URL just in case\\n        apiService.setBaseUrl(\\n          configManager.get(\\\"api_url\\\") || \\\"https://openrouter.ai/api/v1\\\",\\n        );\\n      });\\n    }\\n  }, []);\\n\\n  // Expose calculateCost function for use elsewhere\\n  const getCalculateCost = () =&amp;gt; calculateCost;\\n\\n  const computeCostFromUsage = (modelId, promptTokens, completionTokens) =&amp;gt; {\\n    const pricing =\\n      allModels.find((m) =&amp;gt; m.id === modelId)?.pricing ||\\n      settings.cached_models?.find((m) =&amp;gt; m.id === modelId)?.pricing;\\n    const promptRate = parseFloat(pricing?.prompt ?? 0);\\n    const completionRate = parseFloat(pricing?.completion ?? 0);\\n    if (promptRate || completionRate) {\\n      return promptTokens * promptRate + completionTokens * completionRate;\\n    }\\n    // If pricing is missing, treat as free (avoid default/fallback pricing).\\n    return 0;\\n  };\\n\\n  const writeLastApiResult = (payload) =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      const electronRequire =\\n        typeof window !== \\\"undefined\\\" &amp;amp;&amp;amp; window.require ? window.require : null;\\n      if (!electronRequire) return;\\n      const fs = electronRequire(\\\"fs\\\");\\n      const path = electronRequire(\\\"path\\\");\\n      const filePath = path.join(process.cwd(), \\\"last_api_result.json\\\");\\n      fs.writeFileSync(filePath, JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2), \\\"utf8\\\");\\n    } catch (err) {\\n      console.error(\\\"Failed to write last_api_result.json\\\", err);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  // Update settings\\n  const updateSettings = (newSettings) =&amp;gt; {\\n    configManager.setAll(newSettings);\\n    const updatedSettings = configManager.getAll();\\n    setSettings(updatedSettings);\\n\\n    // Update the API service base URL when settings change\\n    apiService.setBaseUrl(\\n      updatedSettings.api_url || \\\"https://openrouter.ai/api/v1\\\",\\n    );\\n  };\\n\\n  // Update a single setting\\n  const setSetting = (key, value) =&amp;gt; {\\n    configManager.set(key, value);\\n    const updatedSettings = configManager.getAll();\\n    setSettings(updatedSettings);\\n\\n    // Update the API service base URL when settings change\\n    if (key === \\\"api_url\\\") {\\n      apiService.setBaseUrl(value || \\\"https://openrouter.ai/api/v1\\\");\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  // Translate text\\n  const translate = async (text, targetLang, model, sourceLang = null) =&amp;gt; {\\n    setLoading(true);\\n    setError(null);\\n\\n    try {\\n      const result = await apiService.translate(\\n        text,\\n        targetLang,\\n        model,\\n        sourceLang,\\n      );\\n\\n      // Update last used model\\n      // Do not overwrite last_used_model here; it is persisted via user selection in the header.\\n\\n      // Update total cost if applicable\\n      if (result.usage) {\\n        const { prompt_tokens = 0, completion_tokens = 0 } = result.usage;\\n        const calculatedCost = computeCostFromUsage(\\n          model,\\n          prompt_tokens,\\n          completion_tokens,\\n        );\\n        const newTotalCost = (settings.total_cost || 0) + calculatedCost;\\n        setSetting(\\\"total_cost\\\", newTotalCost);\\n        result.calculated_cost = calculatedCost;\\n        result.total_cost = newTotalCost;\\n      }\\n\\n      result.model_used = result.model || model;\\n\\n      writeLastApiResult({\\n        type: \\\"translate\\\",\\n        model: result.model_used,\\n        usage: result.usage,\\n        calculated_cost: result.calculated_cost,\\n        total_cost: result.total_cost,\\n        raw: result,\\n      });\\n\\n      return result;\\n    } catch (err) {\\n      setError(\\\"Translation failed\\\");\\n      console.error(err);\\n      return { error: err.message };\\n    } finally {\\n      setLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  // Rewrite text\\n  const rewrite = async (text, style, model) =&amp;gt; {\\n    setLoading(true);\\n    setError(null);\\n\\n    try {\\n      const result = await apiService.rewrite(text, style, model);\\n\\n      // Update last used model\\n      // Do not overwrite last_used_model here; it is persisted via user selection in the header.\\n\\n      // Update total cost if applicable\\n      if (result.usage) {\\n        const { prompt_tokens = 0, completion_tokens = 0 } = result.usage;\\n        const calculatedCost = computeCostFromUsage(\\n          model,\\n          prompt_tokens,\\n          completion_tokens,\\n        );\\n        const newTotalCost = (settings.total_cost || 0) + calculatedCost;\\n        setSetting(\\\"total_cost\\\", newTotalCost);\\n        result.calculated_cost = calculatedCost;\\n        result.total_cost = newTotalCost;\\n      }\\n\\n      result.model_used = result.model || model;\\n\\n      writeLastApiResult({\\n        type: \\\"rewrite\\\",\\n        model: result.model_used,\\n        usage: result.usage,\\n        calculated_cost: result.calculated_cost,\\n        total_cost: result.total_cost,\\n        raw: result,\\n      });\\n\\n      return result;\\n    } catch (err) {\\n      setError(\\\"Rewrite failed\\\");\\n      console.error(err);\\n      return { error: err.message };\\n    } finally {\\n      setLoading(false);\\n    }\\n  };\\n\\n  // Context value\\n  const contextValue = {\\n    settings,\\n    models: availableModels, // Expose user selected models as 'models' for backward compat\\n    allModels, // Expose full list for settings\\n    availableModels,\\n    languages,\\n    loading,\\n    error,\\n    updateSettings,\\n    setSetting,\\n    translate,\\n    rewrite,\\n    calculateCost: getCalculateCost(),\\n  };\\n\\n  return (\\n    &amp;lt;AppContext.Provider value={contextValue}&amp;gt;{children}&amp;lt;/AppContext.Provider&amp;gt;\\n  );\\n};\\n\\n// Hook to use the context\\nexport const useAppContext = () =&amp;gt; {\\n  const context = useContext(AppContext);\\n  if (!context) {\\n    throw new Error(\\\"useAppContext must be used within an AppProvider\\\");\\n  }\\n  return context;\\n};\\n\\nexport default AppContext;\\n\","

Translate the following text from ${sourceLang} into ${targetLang}. Only provide the translation, no introductory or concluding remarks.&#96;;\n      } else {\n        prompt = &#96;You are a professional translator. Translate the following text into ${targetLang}. Only provide the translation, no introductory or concluding remarks.&#96;;\n      }\n\n      const response = await fetch(&#96;${this.baseUrl}/chat/completions&#96;, {\n        method: \"POST\",\n        headers: this.getHeaders(),\n        body: JSON.stringify({\n          model: model,\n          messages: [\n            { role: \"system\", content: prompt },\n            { role: \"user\", content: text },\n          ],\n        }),\n      });\n\n      if (!response.ok) {\n        throw new Error(&#96;HTTP error! status: ${response.status}&#96;);\n      }\n\n      const data = await response.json();\n\n      if (!data.choices || data.choices.length === 0) {\n        throw new Error(\"No choices returned from API\");\n      }\n\n      const result = {\n        content: data.choices[0].message.content,\n        usage: data.usage,\n        model: model,\n      };\n\n      this.writeLastApiResult({\n        type: \"translate\",\n        model,\n        usage: data.usage,\n        raw: data,\n      });\n\n      return result;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"Translation error:\", error);\n      return {\n        error: error.message,\n      };\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Rewrite text with specified style\n   * @param {string} text - Text to rewrite\n   * @param {string} style - Style to apply\n   * @param {string} model - Model to use for rewriting\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;Object&gt;} Rewrite result with content and usage\n   */\n  async rewrite(text, style, model) {\n    try {\n      const stylePrompts = {\n        \"Check Spelling &amp; Grammar\":\n          \"Correct the spelling and grammar of the following text. Maintain the original meaning.\",\n        \"Improve Clarity\":\n          \"Rewrite the following text to improve its clarity and flow.\",\n        \"Make Formal\":\n          \"Rewrite the following text to make it more formal and professional.\",\n        \"Make Informal\":\n          \"Rewrite the following text to make it more casual and informal.\",\n        Shorten:\n          \"Condense the following text, keeping only the essential information.\",\n        Expand: \"Expand on the following text, adding more detail and context.\",\n        \"Make Technical\":\n          \"Rewrite the following text using more technical terminology appropriate for the context.\",\n      };\n\n      const prompt = stylePrompts[style] || \"Rewrite the following text.\";\n\n      const response = await fetch(&#96;${this.baseUrl}/chat/completions&#96;, {\n        method: \"POST\",\n        headers: this.getHeaders(),\n        body: JSON.stringify({\n          model: model,\n          messages: [\n            {\n              role: \"system\",\n              content: &#96;${prompt} Only provide the rewritten text, no introductory or concluding remarks.&#96;,\n            },\n            { role: \"user\", content: text },\n          ],\n        }),\n      });\n\n      if (!response.ok) {\n        throw new Error(&#96;HTTP error! status: ${response.status}&#96;);\n      }\n\n      const data = await response.json();\n\n      if (!data.choices || data.choices.length === 0) {\n        throw new Error(\"No choices returned from API\");\n      }\n\n      const result = {\n        content: data.choices[0].message.content,\n        usage: data.usage,\n        model: model,\n      };\n\n      this.writeLastApiResult({\n        type: \"rewrite\",\n        model,\n        usage: data.usage,\n        raw: data,\n      });\n\n      return result;\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"Rewrite error:\", error);\n      return {\n        error: error.message,\n      };\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Get list of available models\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;Array&gt;} List of available models\n   */\n  async getModels() {\n    try {\n      const response = await fetch(&#96;${this.baseUrl}/models&#96;, {\n        headers: this.getHeaders(),\n      });\n\n      if (!response.ok) {\n        throw new Error(&#96;HTTP error! status: ${response.status}&#96;);\n      }\n\n      const data = await response.json();\n      return data.data || [];\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"Error fetching models:\", error);\n      return [];\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Get list of available languages\n   * @returns {Promise&lt;Array&gt;} List of available languages\n   */\n  async getLanguages() {\n    try {\n      const response = await fetch(&#96;${this.baseUrl}/languages&#96;);\n\n      if (!response.ok) {\n        throw new Error(&#96;HTTP error! status: ${response.status}&#96;);\n      }\n\n      const data = await response.json();\n      return data.languages || [];\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"Error fetching languages:\", error);\n      return [];\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nexport default new APIService();\n",

## Summary of Changes

1. **API URL text field**: Added in the "API Configuration" section of the General tab. Defaults to `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1` if not set.

2. **Show API Key checkbox**: Added next to the API Key input to toggle between password and text. The checkbox is labeled "Show" and is inline with the input.

3. **Test API Configuration button**: Added below the API Key field. It:
   - Validates that both URL and Key are provided
   - Makes a direct API call to test the connection
   - Shows a loading state ("Testing...") while testing
   - Displays success/error messages with color coding (green for success, red for error)
   - Shows the number of models found on success
   - Provides detailed error messages on failure

4. **State management**:
   - Test status and messages reset when the API URL or Key changes
   - State resets when the dialog opens
   - Settings are auto-saved as the user types

The implementation uses direct fetch calls for testing, so it doesn't modify global state. The UI provides clear feedback on the API connection status.

        "contents": "class ConfigManager {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Load configuration from localStorage\n   */\n  loadConfig() {\n    try {\n      // First try to load from localStorage\n      const savedConfig = localStorage.getItem(\"translator_rewriter_config\");\n      if (savedConfig) {\n        this.config = JSON.parse(savedConfig);\n      } else {\n        this.config = {};\n      }\n\n      // If running in Electron, try to load from file and merge\n      if (window.electronAPI) {\n        const fileConfig = window.electronAPI.readConfig();\n        // readConfig() always returns an object (never null), either from config.json or config_default.json\n        if (fileConfig &amp;&amp; Object.keys(fileConfig).length &gt; 0) {\n          this.config = { ...this.config, ...fileConfig };\n          console.log(\"Loaded config from file:\", this.config);\n        }\n      }\n      \n      // If config is still empty after all attempts, log a warning\n      // This should not happen in Electron since readConfig() creates config from defaults\n      if (Object.keys(this.config).length === 0) {\n        console.warn(\"No configuration loaded. This may cause issues.\");\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"Error loading config:\", error);\n      // Keep empty config - readConfig() should have handled defaults\n    }\n  }\n\n  persistToFile() {\n    try {\n      const electronRequire =\n        typeof window !== \"undefined\" &amp;&amp; window.require;\n  }",

        "contents": "// See the Electron documentation for details on how to use preload scripts:\n// https://www.electronjs.org/docs/latest/tutorial/process-model#preload-scripts\n\n// All of the Node.js APIs are available in the preload process.\n// It has the same sandbox as a Chrome extension.\nconst { contextBridge, ipcRenderer } = require('electron');\nconst fs = require('fs');\nconst path = require('path');\n\nconst api = {\n  readConfig: () =&gt; {\n    try {\n      // Determine paths for both development and production\n      // In production, extraFiles are placed in resources directory or alongside executable\n      const resourcesPath = process.resourcesPath || path.dirname(process.execPath);\n      const appPath = process.env.PORTABLE_EXECUTABLE_DIR || process.cwd();\n      \n      // Look for config.json in multiple locations to be robust\n      const pathsToCheck = [\n        // Production: resources directory (where extraFiles are typically placed)\n        path.join(resourcesPath, 'config.json'),\n        // Production: alongside executable (for portable apps)\n        path.join(path.dirname(process.execPath), 'config.json'),\n        // Development path relative to this file (src/main/preload.js -&gt; root/config.json)\n        path.join(__dirname, '../../config.json'),\n        // Current working directory\n        path.resolve('config.json'),\n        // App path\n        path.join(appPath, 'config.json'),\n        // Parent of CWD (sometimes useful)\n        path.resolve('../config.json')\n      ];\n\n      let configPath = null;\n      for (const p of pathsToCheck) {\n        if (fs.existsSync(p)) {\n          configPath = p;\n          break;\n        }\n      }\n\n      if (configPath) {\n        console.log\n  }\n};",

        "contents": "import json\nimport os\n\nCONFIG_FILE = \"config.json\"\n\nDEFAULT_CONFIG = {\n    \"api_key\": \"\",\n    \"available_models\": [],\n    \"cached_models\": [],\n    \"last_used_model\": \"\",\n    \"theme\": \"System\",\n    \"available_languages\": [\"Spanish\", \"French\", \"German\", \"Italian\", \"Brazilian Portuguese\", \"Russian\", \"Japanese\", \"Chinese\", \"Korean\", \"English (US)\", \"English (UK)\", \"Spanish (ES)\", \"Spanish (Latam)\"],\n    \"enter_behavior\": \"Shift-Translate\",\n    \"auto_copy\": False,\n    \"real_time_translation\": True,\n    \"font_family\": \"Segoe UI\",\n    \"font_size\": 13,\n    \"input_text_color\": \"white\",\n    \"output_text_color\": \"white\",\n    \"window_geometry\": \"\",\n    \"settings_geometry\": \"\",\n    \"total_cost\": 0.0\n}\n\nclass ConfigManager:\n    def __init__(self):\n        self.config = self.load_config()\n\n    def load_config(self):\n        if not os.path.exists(CONFIG_FILE):\n            return DEFAULT_CONFIG.copy()\n        try:\n            with open(CONFIG_FILE, \"r\") as f:\n                return json.load(f)\n        except json.JSONDecodeError:\n            return DEFAULT_CONFIG.copy()\n\n    def save_config(self):\n        with open(CONFIG_FILE, \"w\") as f:\n            json.dump(self.config, f, indent=4)\n\n    def get(self, key):\n        return self.config.get(key, DEFAULT_CONFIG.get(key))\n\n    def set(self, key, value):\n        self.config[key] = value\n        self.save_config()",

        "contents": "let mainWindow = null;\nlet settingsWindow = null;\n\nconst createWindow = () =&gt; {\n  // Load saved window state\n  const savedState = loadWindowState();\n\n  // Create the browser window.\n  mainWindow = new BrowserWindow({\n    x: savedState ? savedState.x : undefined,\n    y: savedState ? savedState.y : undefined,\n    width: savedState ? savedState.width : 1000,\n    height: savedState ? savedState.height : 700,\n    icon: path.join(__dirname, \"../../tr_logo.ico\"),\n    webPreferences: {\n      preload: path.join(__dirname, \"preload.js\"),\n      nodeIntegration: true,\n      contextIsolation: false,\n    },\n  });\n\n  // Restore maximized state\n  if (savedState &amp;&amp; savedState.isMaximized) {\n    mainWindow.maximize();\n  }\n\n  // Save window state on resize, move, and close\n  mainWindow.on(\"resize\", () =&gt; saveWindowState(mainWindow));\n  mainWindow.on(\"move\", () =&gt; saveWindowState(mainWindow));\n\n  // and load the index.html of the app.\n  if (process.env.NODE_ENV === \"development\") {\n    mainWindow.loadURL(\"http://localhost:3000\");\n    mainWindow.webContents.openDevTools();\n  } else {\n    mainWindow.loadFile(path.join(__dirname, \"../../dist/index.html\"));\n  }\n\n  // Remove menu bar\n  mainWindow.setMenuBarVisibility(false);\n\n  // Close settings window when main window closes\n  mainWindow.on(\"close\", () =&gt; {\n    saveWindowState(mainWindow);\n    // Close settings window if it's open\n    if (settingsWindow &amp;&amp; !settingsWindow.isDestroyed()) {\n      settingsWindow.close();\n    }\n  });\n\n  mainWindow.on(\"closed\", () =&gt; {\n    mainWindow = null;\n  });\n};\n\nconst createSettingsWindow = () =&gt; {\n  if (settingsWindow)\n;",

        "contents": "def main():\n    global API_KEY\n    \n    print(f\"{Colors.BOLD}{Colors.BLUE}\")\n    print(\"=\" * 60)\n    print(\"OpenRouter Proxy Test Suite\")\n    print(\"=\" * 60)\n    print(f\"{Colors.RESET}\")\n    \n    # Load API key from config.json\n    config_manager = ConfigManager()\n    API_KEY = config_manager.get(\"api_key\")\n    \n    # Allow override from command line argument\n    if len(sys.argv) &gt; 1:\n        API_KEY = sys.argv[1]\n        print_info(f\"Using API key from command line argument\")\n    elif API_KEY:\n        print_info(f\"Using API key from config.json\")\n    else:\n        print_warning(\"No API key found in config.json\")\n        print_info(\"You can:\")\n        print_info(\"  1. Add 'api_key' to config.json\")\n        print_info(\"  2. Pass API key as command line argument: python test_proxy.py your-api-key\")\n        print_warning(\"Some tests will be skipped without an API key.\")\n    \n    # Test results\n    results = {}\n    \n    # Test 1: Connectivity\n    results['connectivity'] = test_proxy_connectivity(PROXY_URL)\n    \n    if not results['connectivity']:\n        print_error(\"\\nProxy is not reachable.         "contents": "// Provider component\nexport const AppProvider = ({ children }) =&gt; {\n  const [settings, setSettings] = useState(configManager.getAll());\n\n  const [allModels, setAllModels] = useState([]);\n  const [availableModels, setAvailableModels] = useState(\n    configManager.get(\"available_models\") || [],\n  );\n  const [languages, setLanguages] = useState(\n    configManager.get(\"available_languages\") || [],\n  );\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [error, setError] = useState(null);\n\n  // Watch for changes in settings.available_languages and update languages state\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const currentLangs = settings.available_languages || [];\n    // Always update to ensure we have the latest from settings\n    // Create a new array reference to trigger re-renders\n    setLanguages([...currentLangs]);\n  }, [settings.available_languages]);\n\n  // Watch for changes in settings.available_models and update availableModels state\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const currentModels = settings.available_models || [];\n    // Always update to ensure we have the latest from settings\n    // Create a new array reference to trigger re-renders\n    setAvailableModels([...currentModels]);\n  }, [settings.available_models]);\n\n  // Load models and languages on startup\n  useEffect\n\n;",

                  "content": "  \"contents\": \"// See the Electron documentation for details on how to use preload scripts:\\n// https://www.electronjs.org/docs/latest/tutorial/process-model#preload-scripts\\n\\n// All of the Node.js APIs are available in the preload process.\\n// It has the same sandbox as a Chrome extension.\\nconst { contextBridge, ipcRenderer } = require('electron');\\nconst fs = require('fs');\\nconst path = require('path');\\n\\nconst api = {\\n  readConfig: () =&amp;gt; {\\n    try {\\n      // Look for config.json in multiple locations to be robust\\n      const pathsToCheck = [\\n        // Development path relative to this file (src/main/preload.js -&amp;gt; root/config.json)\\n        path.join(__dirname, '../../config.json'),\\n        // Current working directory\\n        path.resolve('config.json'),\\n        // Parent of CWD (sometimes useful)\\n        path.resolve('../config.json')\\n      ];\\n\\n      let configPath = null;\\n      for (const p of pathsToCheck) {\\n        if (fs.existsSync(p)) {\\n          configPath = p;\\n          break;\\n        }\\n      }\\n\\n      if (configPath) {\\n        console.log(&amp;#96;Loading config from: ${configPath}&amp;#96;);\\n        const data = fs.readFileSync(configPath, 'utf8');\\n        return JSON.parse(data);\\n      } else {\\n        // Config.json not found, try to load from config_default.json and create config.json\\n        console.log('Config file not found. Attempting to load defaults from config_default.json');\\n        const defaultPathsToCheck = [\\n          path.join(__dirname, '../../config_default.json'),\\n          path.resolve('config_default.json'),\\n          path.resolve('../config_default.json')\\n        ];\\n\\n        let defaultConfigPath = null;\\n        for (const p of defaultPathsToCheck) {\\n          if (fs.existsSync(p)) {\\n            defaultConfigPath = p;\\n            break;\\n          }\\n        }\\n\\n        if (defaultConfigPath) {\\n          console.log(&amp;#96;Loading default config from: ${defaultConfigPath}&amp;#96;);\\n          const defaultData = fs.readFileSync(defaultConfigPath, 'utf8');\\n          const defaultConfig = JSON.parse(defaultData);\\n          \\n          // Create config.json with default values in the same directory as config_default.json\\n          const configDir = path.dirname(defaultConfigPath);\\n          const newConfigPath = path.join(configDir, 'config.json');\\n          fs.writeFileSync(newConfigPath, JSON.stringify(defaultConfig, null, 2), 'utf8');\\n          console.log(&amp;#96;Created config.json from defaults at: ${newConfigPath}&amp;#96;);\\n          \\n          return defaultConfig;\\n        } else {\\n          console.error('Neither config.json nor config_default.json found. Checked paths:', pathsToCheck, defaultPathsToCheck);\\n        }\\n      }\\n    } catch (e) {\\n      console.error('Failed to read config file', e);\\n    }\\n    return null;\\n  },\\n  openSettings: () =&amp;gt; ipcRenderer.send('open-settings'),\\n  notifySettingsUpdated: () =&amp;gt; ipcRenderer.send('settings-updated'),\\n  onSettingsUpdated: (callback) =&amp;gt; ipcRenderer.on('settings-updated', callback)\\n};\\n\\ntry {\\n  contextBridge.exposeInMainWorld('electronAPI', api);\\n} catch (e) {\\n  // If contextIsolation is disabled, contextBridge might fail or not work as expected\\n  // Fallback to direct assignment\\n  window.electronAPI = api;\\n}\\n\\n// Ensure it's available in non-isolated contexts if contextBridge didn't throw but didn't work (common in some electron configs)\\nif (!window.electronAPI) {\\n  window.electronAPI = api;\\n}\\n\\nwindow.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () =&amp;gt; {\\n  const replaceText = (selector, text) =&amp;gt; {\\n    const element = document.getElementById(selector);\\n    if (element) element.innerText = text;\\n  };\\n\\n  for (const type of ['chrome', 'node', 'electron']) {\\n    replaceText(&amp;#96;${type}-version&amp;#96;, process.versions[type]);\\n  }\\n});\","

{\n    try {\n      // Determine paths for both development and production\n      // In production, extraFiles are placed in resources directory or alongside executable\n      const resourcesPath = process.resourcesPath || path.dirname(process.execPath);\n      const appPath = process.env.PORTABLE_EXECUTABLE_DIR || process.cwd();\n      \n      // Look for config.json in multiple locations to be robust\n      const pathsToCheck = [\n        // Production: resources directory (where extraFiles are typically placed)\n        path.join(resourcesPath, 'config.json'),\n        // Production: alongside executable (for portable apps)\n        path.join(path.dirname(process.execPath), 'config.json'),\n        // Development path relative to this file (src/main/preload.js -&gt; root/config.json)\n        path.join(__dirname, '../../config.json'),\n        // Current working directory\n        path.resolve('config.json'),\n        // App path\n        path.join(appPath, 'config.json'),\n        // Parent of CWD (sometimes useful)\n        path.resolve('../config.json')\n      ];\n\n      let configPath = null;\n      for (const p of pathsToCheck) {\n        if (fs.existsSync(p)) {\n          configPath = p;\n          break;\n        }\n      }\n\n      if (configPath) {\n        console.log(&#96;Loading config from: ${configPath}&#96;);\n        const data = fs.readFileSync(configPath, 'utf8');\n        return JSON.parse(data);\n      } else {\n        // Config.json not found, try to load from config_default.json and create config.json\n        console.log('Config file not found. Attempting to load defaults from config_default.json');\n        const defaultPathsToCheck = [\n          // Production: resources directory (where extraFiles are typically placed)\n          path.join(resourcesPath, 'config_default.json'),\n          // Production: alongside executable (for portable apps)\n          path.join(path.dirname(process.execPath), 'config_default.json'),\n          // Development path relative to this file\n          path.join(__dirname, '../../config_default.json'),\n          path.resolve('config_default.json'),\n          // App path\n          path.join(appPath, 'config_default.json'),\n          path.resolve('../config_default.json')\n        ];\n\n        let defaultConfigPath = null;\n        for (const p of defaultPathsToCheck) {\n          if (fs.existsSync(p)) {\n            defaultConfigPath = p;\n            break;\n          }\n        }\n\n        if (defaultConfigPath) {\n          console.log(&#96;Loading default config from: ${defaultConfigPath}&#96;);\n          const defaultData = fs.readFileSync(defaultConfigPath, 'utf8');\n          const defaultConfig = JSON.parse(defaultData);\n          \n          // Create config.json with default values in the same directory as config_default.json\n          const configDir = path.dirname(defaultConfigPath);\n          const newConfigPath = path.join(configDir, 'config.json');\n          fs.writeFileSync(newConfigPath, JSON.stringify(defaultConfig, null, 2), 'utf8');\n          console.log(&#96;Created config.json from defaults at: ${newConfigPath}&#96;);\n          \n          return defaultConfig;\n        } else {\n          console.error('Neither config.json nor config_default.json found. Checked paths:', pathsToCheck, defaultPathsToCheck);\n          // Return empty config as fallback - this should rarely happen if config_default.json is properly packaged\n          return {};\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (e) {\n      console.error('Failed to read config file', e);\n      // Return empty config as fallback\n      return {};\n    }\n  },\n  openSettings: () =&gt; ipcRenderer.send('open-settings'),\n  notifySettingsUpdated: () =&gt; ipcRenderer.send('settings-updated'),\n  onSettingsUpdated: (callback) =&gt; ipcRenderer.on('settings-updated', callback)\n};\n\ntry {\n  contextBridge.exposeInMainWorld('electronAPI', api);\n} catch (e) {\n  // If contextIsolation is disabled, contextBridge might fail or not work as expected\n  // Fallback to direct assignment\n  window.electronAPI = api;\n}\n\n// Ensure it's available in non-isolated contexts if contextBridge didn't throw but didn't work (common in some electron configs)\nif (!window.electronAPI) {\n  window.electronAPI = api;\n}\n\nwindow.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () =&gt; {\n  const replaceText = (selector, text) =&gt; {\n    const element = document.getElementById(selector);\n    if (element) element.innerText = text;\n  };\n\n  for (const type of ['chrome', 'node', 'electron']) {\n    replaceText(&#96;${type}-version&#96;, process.versions[type]);\n  }\n});",

        "contents": "let mainWindow = null;\nlet settingsWindow = null;\n\nconst createWindow = () =&gt; {\n  // Load saved window state\n  const savedState = loadWindowState();\n\n  // Create the browser window.\n  mainWindow = new BrowserWindow({\n    x: savedState ? savedState.x : undefined,\n    y: savedState ? savedState.y : undefined,\n    width: savedState ? savedState.width : 1000,\n    height: savedState ? savedState.height : 700,\n    icon: path.join(__dirname, \"../../tr_logo.ico\"),\n    webPreferences: {\n      preload: path.join(__dirname, \"preload.js\"),\n      nodeIntegration: true,\n      contextIsolation: false,\n    },\n  });\n\n  // Restore maximized state\n  if (savedState &amp;&amp; savedState.isMaximized) {\n    mainWindow.maximize();\n  }\n\n  // Save window state on resize, move, and close\n  mainWindow.on(\"resize\", () =&gt; saveWindowState(mainWindow));\n  mainWindow.on(\"move\", () =&gt; saveWindowState(mainWindow));\n\n  // and load the index.html of the app.\n  if (process.env.NODE_ENV === \"development\") {\n    mainWindow.loadURL(\"http://localhost:3000\");\n    mainWindow.webContents.openDevTools();\n  } else {\n    mainWindow.loadFile(path.join(__dirname, \"../../dist/index.html\"));\n  }\n\n  // Remove menu bar\n  mainWindow.setMenuBarVisibility(false);\n\n  // Close settings window when main window closes\n  mainWindow.on(\"close\", () =&gt; {\n    saveWindowState(mainWindow);\n    // Close settings window if it's open\n    if (settingsWindow &amp;&amp; !settingsWindow.isDestroyed()) {\n      settingsWindow.close();\n    }\n  });\n\n  mainWindow.on(\"closed\", () =&gt; {\n    mainWindow = null;\n  });\n};\n\nconst createSettingsWindow = () =&gt; {\n  if (settingsWindow)\n;",

        "contents": "class ConfigManager {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Load configuration from localStorage\n   */\n  loadConfig() {\n    try {\n      // First try to load from localStorage\n      const savedConfig = localStorage.getItem(\"translator_rewriter_config\");\n      if (savedConfig) {\n        this.config = JSON.parse(savedConfig);\n      } else {\n        this.config = {};\n      }\n\n      // If running in Electron, try to load from file and merge\n      if (window.electronAPI) {\n        const fileConfig = window.electronAPI.readConfig();\n        // readConfig() always returns an object (never null), either from config.json or config_default.json\n        if (fileConfig &amp;&amp; Object.keys(fileConfig).length &gt; 0) {\n          this.config = { ...this.config, ...fileConfig };\n          console.log(\"Loaded config from file:\", this.config);\n        }\n      }\n      \n      // If config is still empty after all attempts, log a warning\n      // This should not happen in Electron since readConfig() creates config from defaults\n      if (Object.keys(this.config).length === 0) {\n        console.warn(\"No configuration loaded. This may cause issues.\");\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"Error loading config:\", error);\n      // Keep empty config - readConfig() should have handled defaults\n    }\n  }\n\n  persistToFile() {\n    try {\n      const electronRequire =\n        typeof window !== \"undefined\" &amp;&amp; window.require;\n  }",

        "contents": "# Building on Windows 11\n\n## Common Issues and Solutions\n\n### Symlink Permission Errors\n\nIf you encounter errors like:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nERROR: Cannot create symbolic link : A required privilege is not held by the client.\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Solution 1: Enable Developer Mode (Recommended)**\n1. Press &#96;Win + I&#96; to open Settings\n2. Go to **Privacy &amp; Security** → **For developers**\n3. Toggle **Developer Mode** to **On**\n4. Restart your terminal/PowerShell\n5. Run &#96;npm run package&#96; again\n\n**Solution 2: Run as Administrator**\n- Right-click PowerShell → **Run as administrator**\n- Navigate to project directory\n- Run &#96;npm run package&#96;\n\n### Current Configuration\n\nThe &#96;package.json&#96; is configured with:\n- &#96;forceCodeSigning: false&#96; - Disables code signing\n- &#96;CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false&#96; - Prevents certificate auto-discovery\n- &#96;ELECTRON_BUILDER_CACHE=./cache&#96; - Uses local cache directory\n\nThis configuration should work without Developer Mode, but enabling Developer Mode is the most reliable solution.\n\n### Build Command\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm run package\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThis will:\n1. Build the renderer (webpack)\n2. Package the Electron app using electron-builder\n3. Create an NSIS installer in the &#96;release&#96; directory",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "These commands are used to create the final production version of the application, ready for distribution.\n\n3.1 Build Renderer (React) for Production\nThis step compiles your React application into optimized, production-ready assets (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) and typically places them in a dist folder.\n\nCommand\tAction\nnpm run build-renderer\tExecutes webpack in production mode.\n\nExport to Sheets\n\n3.2 Package the Application (Executable/Installer)\nThis is the final step, which runs the production build and then uses Electron Builder to package the app for your target operating system (e.g., creating a .exe installer for Windows).\n\nCommand\tAction\nnpm run package\tRuns build-renderer, then executes electron-builder.\n\nExport to Sheets\n\nOutput Location:\n\nPackaged installers and binaries will be output to the release directory, as defined in the package.json configuration.\n\n4. Key Configuration Files\nFile\tDescription\npackage.json\tContains project metadata, dependency lists, and the core scripts for development and building. Also holds the configuration block for electron-builder.\nwebpack.config.js\t(Assumed) Defines how React components are compiled, bundled, and where the final assets are output (e.g., the dist folder).\nsrc/main/main.js\tThe main entry point for the Electron process, responsible for creating the native window and loading the compiled React content.",

Overall application layout (&#96;src/renderer/components/MainLayout.js&#96;)\n- ✅ Header - Top application bar (&#96;src/renderer/components/Header.js&#96;)\n- ✅ ModeSelector - Toggle between modes (&#96;src/renderer/components/ModeSelector.js&#96;)\n- ✅ ResizablePanels - Split view for input/output (&#96;src/renderer/components/ResizablePanels.js&#96;)\n- ✅ TextEditor - Enhanced text input/output areas (&#96;src/renderer/components/TextPanel.js&#96;)\n\n### ✅ Session 3: Configuration and State Management (COMPLETED)\n**Tasks:**",

The configManager looks fine. The issue is likely that `config_default.json` isn't found in production, or it's found but writing `config.json` fails silently. The fix addresses both.

## Summary of Fixes

1. **Multiple writable locations**: When creating `config.json` from defaults, the code now tries multiple writable locations instead of only the same directory as `config_default.json` (which may be read-only in production).

2. **Error handling**: Write errors are caught and logged, and the code continues trying other locations.

3. **Always return defaults**: Even if writing `config.json` fails, the function still returns the default config from `config_default.json`, so the app can use it.

4. **Better logging**: Added logging to help diagnose issues on test machines, including:
   - Which paths were checked
   - Where `config_default.json` was found
   - Where `config.json` was successfully created (or why it failed)
   - Current working directory and executable paths

5. **User home directory fallback**: Added the user's home directory as a fallback writable location (though it's tried after more appropriate locations).

The key change is that the function now returns the default config even if it can't write `config.json` to disk, so the app will use the defaults from `config_default.json` even in read-only environments.

To test this on your test machine, check the console logs when the app starts. They will show:
- Whether `config_default.json` was found and where
- Whether `config.json` was created and where (or why it failed)
- All paths that were checked

This should resolve the issue where defaults weren't being used when `config.json` didn't exist.

        "contents": "# Building on Windows 11\n\n## Common Issues and Solutions\n\n### Symlink Permission Errors\n\nIf you encounter errors like:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nERROR: Cannot create symbolic link : A required privilege is not held by the client.\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Solution 1: Enable Developer Mode (Recommended)**\n1. Press &#96;Win + I&#96; to open Settings\n2. Go to **Privacy &amp; Security** → **For developers**\n3. Toggle **Developer Mode** to **On**\n4. Restart your terminal/PowerShell\n5. Run &#96;npm run package&#96; again\n\n**Solution 2: Run as Administrator**\n- Right-click PowerShell → **Run as administrator**\n- Navigate to project directory\n- Run &#96;npm run package&#96;\n\n### Current Configuration\n\nThe &#96;package.json&#96; is configured with:\n- &#96;forceCodeSigning: false&#96; - Disables code signing\n- &#96;CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false&#96; - Prevents certificate auto-discovery\n- &#96;ELECTRON_BUILDER_CACHE=./cache&#96; - Uses local cache directory\n\nThis configuration should work without Developer Mode, but enabling Developer Mode is the most reliable solution.\n\n### Build Command\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm run package\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThis will:\n1. Build the renderer (webpack)\n2. Package the Electron app using electron-builder\n3. Create an NSIS installer in the &#96;release&#96; directory",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Building on Windows 11",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "## Common Issues and Solutions",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "### Symlink Permission Errors",

          {
            "lineNumber": 6

          {
            "text": "If you encounter errors like:",

            "text": "ERROR: Cannot create symbolic link : A required privilege is not held by the client.",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "**Solution 1: Enable Developer Mode (Recommended)**",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "1. Press &#96;Win + I&#96; to open Settings",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "2. Go to **Privacy &amp; Security** → **For developers**",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "3. Toggle **Developer Mode** to **On**",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "4. Restart your terminal/PowerShell",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "5. Run &#96;npm run package&#96; again",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "**Solution 2: Run as Administrator**",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "- Right-click PowerShell → **Run as administrator**",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "- Navigate to project directory",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "- Run &#96;npm run package&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "### Current Configuration",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "The &#96;package.json&#96; is configured with:",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;forceCodeSigning: false&#96; - Disables code signing",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false&#96; - Prevents certificate auto-discovery",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;ELECTRON_BUILDER_CACHE=./cache&#96; - Uses local cache directory",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "This configuration should work without Developer Mode, but enabling Developer Mode is the most reliable solution.",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "### Build Command",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "npm run package",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "This will:",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "1. Build the renderer (webpack)",

          },
          {
            "text": "2. Package the Electron app using electron-builder",

          },
          {
            "text": "3. Create an NSIS installer in the &#96;release&#96; directory",

        "contents": "let mainWindow = null;\nlet settingsWindow = null;\n\nconst createWindow = () =&gt; {\n  // Load saved window state\n  const savedState = loadWindowState();\n\n  // Create the browser window.\n  mainWindow = new BrowserWindow({\n    x: savedState ? savedState.x : undefined,\n    y: savedState ? savedState.y : undefined,\n    width: savedState ? savedState.width : 1000,\n    height: savedState ? savedState.height : 700,\n    icon: path.join(__dirname, \"../../tr_logo.ico\"),\n    webPreferences: {\n      preload: path.join(__dirname, \"preload.js\"),\n      nodeIntegration: true,\n      contextIsolation: false,\n    },\n  });\n\n  // Restore maximized state\n  if (savedState &amp;&amp; savedState.isMaximized) {\n    mainWindow.maximize();\n  }\n\n  // Save window state on resize, move, and close\n  mainWindow.on(\"resize\", () =&gt; saveWindowState(mainWindow));\n  mainWindow.on(\"move\", () =&gt; saveWindowState(mainWindow));\n\n  // and load the index.html of the app.\n  if (process.env.NODE_ENV === \"development\") {\n    mainWindow.loadURL(\"http://localhost:3000\");\n    mainWindow.webContents.openDevTools();\n  } else {\n    mainWindow.loadFile(path.join(__dirname, \"../../dist/index.html\"));\n  }\n\n  // Remove menu bar\n  mainWindow.setMenuBarVisibility(false);\n\n  // Close settings window when main window closes\n  mainWindow.on(\"close\", () =&gt; {\n    saveWindowState(mainWindow);\n    // Close settings window if it's open\n    if (settingsWindow &amp;&amp; !settingsWindow.isDestroyed()) {\n      settingsWindow.close();\n    }\n  });\n\n  mainWindow.on(\"closed\", () =&gt; {\n    mainWindow = null;\n  });\n};\n\nconst createSettingsWindow = () =&gt; {\n  if (settingsWindow)\n;",

        "contents": "These commands are used to create the final production version of the application, ready for distribution.\n\n3.1 Build Renderer (React) for Production\nThis step compiles your React application into optimized, production-ready assets (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) and typically places them in a dist folder.\n\nCommand\tAction\nnpm run build-renderer\tExecutes webpack in production mode.\n\nExport to Sheets\n\n3.2 Package the Application (Executable/Installer)\nThis is the final step, which runs the production build and then uses Electron Builder to package the app for your target operating system (e.g., creating a .exe installer for Windows).\n\nCommand\tAction\nnpm run package\tRuns build-renderer, then executes electron-builder.\n\nExport to Sheets\n\nOutput Location:\n\nPackaged installers and binaries will be output to the release directory, as defined in the package.json configuration.\n\n4. Key Configuration Files\nFile\tDescription\npackage.json\tContains project metadata, dependency lists, and the core scripts for development and building. Also holds the configuration block for electron-builder.\nwebpack.config.js\t(Assumed) Defines how React components are compiled, bundled, and where the final assets are output (e.g., the dist folder).\nsrc/main/main.js\tThe main entry point for the Electron process, responsible for creating the native window and loading the compiled React content.",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\Development and Build Workflow.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 39

        },
        "contents": "# 💻 New Development and Build Workflow\n\n\n\n## 1. Development (npm run dev)\nThis is your new development command.\n\n&#96;npm run watch&#96; (in concurrently) starts Webpack in watch mode, compiling your React code and updating the dist folder whenever you save a file.\n\n&#96;npm run electron&#96; uses wait-on to ensure the Webpack build finishes before launching Electron.\n\nCommand: \n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm run dev\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 2. Building the Renderer (npm run build-renderer)\nThis compiles your React application for production into the dist folder.\n\nCommand: \n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm run build-renderer\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## 3. Packaging the Application (npm run build or npm run package-win)\nThis uses electron-builder to create a final, installable application.\n\n&#96;npm run build-renderer&#96; ensures the latest production React code is bundled.\n\nelectron-builder then takes the compiled files (&#96;dist/**/*&#96; and the main process file) and packages them into an executable.\n\nCommand: \n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm run build # (This runs npm run package-win for convenience)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;",

        "contents": "!include \"installUtil.nsh\"\n    !endif\n\n    Section \"install\" INSTALL_SECTION_ID\n      !ifndef BUILD_UNINSTALLER\n        # If we're running a silent upgrade of a per-machine installation, elevate so extracting the new app will succeed.\n        # For a non-silent install, the elevation will be triggered when the install mode is selected in the UI,\n        # but that won't be executed when silent.\n        !ifndef INSTALL_MODE_PER_ALL_USERS\n          !ifndef ONE_CLICK\n              ${if} $hasPerMachineInstallation == \"1\" # set in onInit by initMultiUser\n              ${andIf} ${Silent}\n                ${ifNot} ${UAC_IsAdmin}\n                  ShowWindow $HWNDPARENT ${SW_HIDE}\n                  !insertmacro UAC_RunElevated\n                  ${Switch} $0\n                    ${Case} 0\n                      ${Break}\n                    ${Case} 1223 ;user aborted\n                      ${Break}\n                    ${Default}\n                      MessageBox mb_IconStop|mb_TopMost|mb_SetForeground \"Unable to elevate, error $0\"\n                      ${Break}\n                  ${EndSwitch}\n                  Quit\n                ${else}\n                  !insertmacro setInstallModePerAllUsers\n                ${endIf}\n              ${endIf}\n          !endif\n        !endif\n        !include \"installSection.nsh\"\n      !endif\n    SectionEnd\n\n    Function setInstallSectionSpaceRequired\n      !insertmacro setSpaceRequired ${INSTALL_SECTION_ID}\n    FunctionEnd\n\n    !ifdef BUILD_UNINSTALLER\n      !include \"uninstaller.nsh\"\n    !endif",

        "contents": "📝 Development Workflow Documentation: Translator &amp; Rewriter\nThis document outlines the standard procedures and commands for developing, running, and packaging the Translator &amp; Rewriter desktop application, which is built using Electron, React, and Webpack.\n\n1. Prerequisites and Setup\nBefore starting development, ensure you have the necessary tools installed and project dependencies handled.\n\nNode.js (LTS): Installed on your system.\n\nGit: Installed for version control.\n\nCode Editor: Visual Studio Code (VS Code) is recommended.\n\nInstall Dependencies: Run the following command in the project root after cloning or creating the directory to install all packages listed in package.json:\n\nBash\n\nnpm install\n2. Core Development Commands\nThe following commands are used during active development and utilize a concurrent setup to manage both the React front-end and the Electron desktop process simultaneously.\n\n2.1 Start Development Mode\nThis is the primary command for development. It automatically starts the Webpack development server and then launches the Electron application, providing live-reloading for your React code.\n\nCommand\tAction\nnpm run dev\tRuns the watch and electron scripts concurrently.\n\nExport to Sheets\n\nUnder the Hood:\n\nnpm run watch: Starts the Webpack dev server, which compiles and serves your React components, typically on http://localhost:8080.\n\nnpm run electron: Uses wait-on to pause until the Webpack server is ready, then launches the Electron main process, which loads the React content into the window.\n\n2.2 Run Electron (Main Process Only)\nThis command is typically used for testing the Electron process directly, often after a production build, or for debugging the main process without the Webpack dev server running.\n\nCommand\tAction\nnpm run start\tDirectly executes the Electron main script (src/main/main.js).\n\nExport to Sheets\n\n3. Building and Packaging\nThese commands are used to create the final production version of the application, ready for distribution.\n\n3.1 Build Renderer (React) for Production",
        "signatures": {},
